meta.description:
It's Anime is a premium anime channel where you can enjoy everything from the latest ongoing series to a vast library of past classics! It brings the best of Japanese animation anytime, all free to you..

Shows: Rampo Kitan: Game of Laplace, KILL BLUE, TOUGEN ANKI, Terror in Resonance, TOUGEN ANKI: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
Available on: Pluto TV, Samsung TV Plus
